native_touch_actions.spawn: Fire pad joins Starwolf from observer
native_touch_actions.move: 3-second upper Move press changes flag distance from 27.3 to 23.2 and moves through the doorway
native_touch_actions.look: Rightward Look drag rotates the original player view and compass
native_touch_actions.weapon: Weapon tap changes blaster to disc launcher
native_touch_actions.fire: 2-second Fire press reduces disc ammo from 15 to 13
native_touch_actions.jet: 6-second Jet press raises the view, drains blue energy and increases red heat; after release the view settles and energy recovers

limitations: Slow startup and visible input delay; no FPS or responsive-playability acceptance
Black triangular gaps visible in some interior views; rendering fidelity incomplete
No physical iPad execution or device provisioning
No online join or authentication; HD sampling acceptance incomplete
scope: Actual full original engine execution and native Simulator touch gameplay actions, not finished platform acceptance.
